_purpose: Stage-2 operating point for the two dark-lesion channels (microaneurysms, haemorrhages): the classifier score above which a candidate is kept, and whether the stage-2 classifier is applied to that channel at all.
_why_this_file_exists: The stage-2 classifier threshold shipped as a literal 0.5 in the
arguments block of detectDarkLesions. Nobody chose it. 0.5 is the
LOOSEST point on the score sweep trainCandidateClassifier already prints,
so the detector was running at the operating point that maximises false
that gates on PRECISION. The knob that trades the failing metric for the
passing one was set to its worst value and was not written down anywhere.
It now lives in a file, is selected on the TRAINING split, and is read at
runtime - the same discipline already applied to the hard/soft exudate
boundary (config/exudate_split.json) and to the referable-DR endpoint
SELECTION IS ON TRAIN, NOT TEST. The held-out IDRiD test split decides
whether a channel may be DISPLAYED; it must never decide what the
detector's own settings are. Picking this threshold on the test split
would make the gate in lesion_validation_thresholds.json meaningless,
because the number it gates would have been chosen to pass it.

selection_rule.objective: the LOWEST classifier threshold whose TRAIN-split micro precision reaches precisionTarget; among ties, the one with the highest recall
selection_rule.precisionTarget_rationale: The display gate is precision >= 0.50 measured on TEST. Selecting on TRAIN at exactly 0.50 would leave zero headroom for the generalisation gap and the channel would fail the gate on any unlucky split. 0.55 is a margin, not a second gate - it is not a claim that 0.55 is achievable.
selection_rule.fallback_if_target_unreachable: report the threshold with the best TRAIN F1 and record reachedTarget=false; the channel then fails the display gate honestly rather than being tuned until it passes

microaneurysms.note: 0.5 is the value that was hardcoded in detectDarkLesions before this file existed. The fallback is deliberately the OLD behaviour rather than a guess, so a machine that has not run the fit does what the project always did.

haemorrhages.note: See docs/phase2_results.md section 4: wiring this classifier in DROPPED held-out F1 from 0.138 to 0.077 (recall 0.174 -> 0.054). That observation came from the TEST split and must not be acted on there. applyClassifier is the switch that decision belongs to, and fitLesionOperatingPoint decides it on TRAIN.

_not_a_display_gate: Nothing in this file may be read as permission to display a channel. Display is decided only by config/lesion_validation_thresholds.json, measured on the held-out test split by validateLesionDetectors.m.
